rationale: Lycopolitan variant of ⲙⲣ̄ⲣⲉ 'bond.' Confirmed by line 8 ⲟⲩⲙⲣⲡⲉ ⲧⲉ ϣⲁⲁⲛⲏϩⲉ 'she is a bond forever' in the bōlos-context.
Lycopolitan reflex of ϣⲣ̄ⲣ̄ 'scatter, disperse' (cf. accumulated ⲭⲣⲁⲣⲁⲧ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'scattered forth').

Greek loanword χρῆμα 'property, possession.' Used three times on this page (lines 30, 31, 33) for the famous man's wealth that was taken from him — the typological vehicle for the First Man's lost light/sons.
Greek loanword ἐπίσημος. Modifies ⲣⲱⲙⲉ in the parable: 'a famous man' — a man of distinction whose loss is correspondingly grave.
Same as above; ⲉⲛ- prefix with ⲉⲡⲓⲥⲏⲙⲟⲥ.
Lycopolitan with prosthetic ⲧ- before ⲭⲓⲥⲉ (= Sah. ϫⲓⲥⲉ 'height'). Cf. accumulated ⲡⲭⲥⲉ 'the Height' (the upper cosmic pole). Here the source-region from which the First Man descends after his sons.
